paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Amasa bang in suangpek nih bawl inla; hiai suangpekte tung ah, na hihsiat suangpek masapente a om thute ka gelh ding.
heading: Suangpek Nihnate / (Diu 10.1-5)
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

paite: Zingsang in mansa in om inla, zingsang in Sinai Tang ah hong paitou inla, tang vum ah ka kiang ah hong kihil in.
english: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.

paite: Na kiang a kuamah ahong paitouh louh ding uh ahi. Tang kimvel a leng kuamah himhim muh a a-om louh ding uh ahi. Tang mazawn lam a bawnghon leh belamhon leng agamtat louh ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

paite: Huchi in amasapen bang in suangpek nih abawl hi. Zingkhang in Mosi athou a, TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in, Sinai Tang ah ahohtou a, akhut in suangpek nihte atawi hi.
english: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as Yahweh had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.

paite: Meipi ah TOUPA ahong kumsuk a, akiang ah ahong dingh a, TOUPA min agenkheta hi.
english: Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.

paite: Huchi in ama ah TOUPA apaisuak a, "TOUPA, TOUPA Pathian, hehpih thei leh it thei, dohthei leh, hoihna leh thutak hau.
english: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

paite: Sangte a dia zahngaihna nei, gitlouhna, tatlekna leh khelhna ngaidam, mohna bangchi mah a siangsak lou ding, pate gitlouhna tate tung leh atusuante tung, akhang thumna leh akhang lina tan a thukpa," chi in apuangkhia hi.
english: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”

paite: Kintak in lei si in Mosi akunsuk a, abeta hi.
english: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

paite: Ama'n, "Tu a na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhleh, TOUPA aw, ka hon ngen hi, ka lak uah ka TOUPA pai hen; migenhak ahih ziak un. Ka gitlouhna uleh ka khelhna uh ngaidam inla, na gouluah ding in hon la in," achi hi.
english: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”

paite: Ama'n: Ngai in, nou toh thukhun ka bawl hi. Leitung pumpi a hih a om ngei lou, koi nam a leng hih a om ngei lou, thillamdangte na mi tengteng ma ah ka hih ding hi. Alak ua na tenna mi tengteng in TOUPA'N nou a dia thil lauhuai ka hih dingte amu ding uh.
heading: Thukhun Thaksak Nawnnanih / (Eks 23.14-19; Diu 7.1-5; 16.1-17)
english: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of Yahweh; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.

paite: Nang tuni a ka hon thupiak zui in. Ngai in na ma uah Amorte, leh Kanaante, leh Hitte, leh Perizte, leh Hivte, leh Jebuste ka hawlkhe ding hi.
english: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

paite: Pilvang in, na paina gam a tengte toh thukhun na bawl kha ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua thang ahi ding uhi.
english: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;

paite: Amaitamte uh hihsia un, amilimte uh hihgawpsak un, a Asherah songte uh na phuksak ding uh ahi.
english: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;

paite: Pathian dang na be ding uh ahi kei: TOUPA, amin Mullit hat ahi a, mullit hat Pathian ahi.
english: for you shall worship no other god; for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

paite: Huai gam a teng mite toh kikal ah thukhun na bawl kha ding uh. Apathiante uh kiang a kithoihna alat chiang in khattei in ahon chial dia, akithoihna sa uh na ne kha ding uh.
english: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;

paite: Na tapate a ding in atanute uh na pisak kha ding ua, atanute uh apathiante uh kiang a akizuak chiang un, na tapate uh leng amaute hih bang a, amilimte uh be ding in akhempuk kha ding uhi.
english: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.

paite: Sunthoh pathiante na kibawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.

paite: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina na nei gige ding uh ahi. Thu ka hon piak tak bang in, Abib kha in, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh; Abib kha a Aigupta a pan a na hong paikhiak ziak un.
english: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.

paite: Sul hong ta masa tengteng, na ganhon lak ua piang masapen teng, bawngtal hi in belam hileh, apa peuhpeuh kei a ahi.
english: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

paite: Himahleh sabiltungnou masapen belamnou in na tatkhiak ding uh ahi. Na tatkhiak kei uleh, angawng na hektan ding uh ahi. Na tapate tengteng lak a piang masapen na tatkhiak ding ahi. Ka ma ah kuamah khutvuak in ahong kilang ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.

paite: Ni guk sung nna na sem ding ahi. Himahleh ani sagih ni in na khawl ding ahi. Haichi pawi hun leh pawltak hun in na khawl ding ahi.
english: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

paite: Nipi kalte a ankuangluina, huit buh pawltak gah masa ankuangluina, kum tawp a koihkhawmna ankuang- luinate na tan ding ahi.
english: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.

paite: Kum khat in thumvei pasal teng- teng Toupa PATHIAN, Israel' Pathian ma a akilat ding uh ahi.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Na mai ua namte ka delhkhe ding a, na gamgi uh ka keklian ding. Kum khat a thumvei TOUPA na Pathian ma a na kilat chiang un, kuamah in na gam uh ahon deihgoh kei ding hi.
english: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before Yahweh, your God, three times in the year.

paite: "Ka mai a kithoihna thillat; silngou toh sisan na lan ding uh ahi kei. Paikan Ankuanglui kithoihna leng azingchiang tan in nutsiat in a-om ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.

paite: Na gam a gah masa hoihpente a masapen TOUPA na Pathian inn ah na hon tawi ding ahi. Kelnou anu' nawitui in na huan ding ahi kei," achi hi.
english: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai thute gelh in. Hiai thute omdan zui a nang leh Israel toh thukhun ka bawl tak ziak in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

paite: TOUPA kiang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli a-om a; an ane kei a, tui leng adawn kei hi. Suangpek tung ah thukhun thute, huai Thupiak Sawmte agelh hi.
english: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

paite: Sinai Tang a kipan akhut a theihpihna suangpek nihte tawi a, tang a kipan Mosi ahong paisuk lai in, amah ahoupih sung in amaitang tang ahi chih Mosi in athei kei hi.
heading: Sinai Mual Tung A Pan Mosi Akumsuk
english: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

paite: Aaron leh Israel suan tengteng in Mosi amuhtak un, ngai in, amaitang atang a; amah naih a hong pai alauta uhi.
english: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

paite: Himahleh Mosi in amaute asam a; Aaron leh mipi kikhawmte heutu tengteng akiang ah ahong kik nawn ua; Mosi in amaute ahoupih hi.
english: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.

paite: Huai nung in Israel suan tengteng ahong pai nai ua; Sinai Tang a TOUPA'N akiang a agen tengteng thupiak in amaute apeta hi.
english: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that Yahweh had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

paite: Mosi in amaute ahoupih khit in, amaitang khuhna in akhuh hi.
english: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA houpih dia amai alut teng in, ahong pawtkhiak nawn mateng, thupiak a omte Israel suante kiang a agen chiang in, amai khuhna ahawkkhia hi.
english: But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

paite: Israel suante'n Mosi maitang amu ua, Mosi maivun atang hi. Mosi in amah houpih dia alut nawn matan in amaitang akhuh zel hi.
english: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
